map.map_01.desc: An L-shaped bend with tower slots along a straight path. Perfect for beginners.
map.map_01.name: Winding Canyon
map.map_02.desc: Two entrances from the left merge at a vertical corridor on the right leading to the base.
map.map_02.name: Forest Twin Path
map.map_03.desc: A U-shaped corridor descending on the left and ascending on the right, with dense tower coverage on both sides.
map.map_03.name: Iron Bastion
map.map_04.desc: A spiral path winding from outer ring to inner ring. Towers are flanked on both sides, making aura towers highly effective.
map.map_04.name: Spiral Fortress
map.map_05.desc: Two independent zigzag paths spawn enemies simultaneously, testing resource allocation and tower placement.
map.map_05.name: Dual Front
map.map_06.desc: A triple-switchback path where enemies pass through tower coverage zones repeatedly. Extremely long route.
map.map_06.name: Labyrinth Corridor
map.map_07.desc: Four switchbacks forming the longest path. All tower slots are flanked on both sides. An extreme challenge.
map.map_07.name: Extreme Narrows
map.map_08.desc: Four entrances from each corner converge through H-shaped corridors to a central base. The ultimate test of all-around defense.
map.map_08.name: The Arena
map.map_dummy.desc: Stationary dummy enemies surrounded by dense tower slots. Built for pure DPS testing.
map.map_dummy.name: Target Range
map.map_test.desc: A compact S-shaped path with 8 tower slots for team composition and simulation testing.
map.map_test.name: Test Arena
map.map_test_large.desc: A 26x13 grid with a serpentine four-bend path and 36 tower slots for large-scale testing.
map.map_test_large.name: Large Test Field

tutorial.step_1: Welcome! This is your defense line. Enemies attack along the path.
tutorial.step_2: Tap the "Build" button below to select a tower.
tutorial.step_3: Tap an empty slot to place the tower. It attacks automatically.
tutorial.step_4: Tap "Start" to begin the first wave!
tutorial.step_5: Tap a placed tower to view its details.
tutorial.step_6: Select "Upgrade" to boost the tower's stats.
tutorial.step_7: Use items to further enhance your towers.
